pages.text: Congratulations on joining $(l)Head Office$(). This handbook covers everything an employee needs: from the $(item)Separation Chair$() to keeping your head topped up with $(item)Cranial Saline$().

Start with $(item)Surgical Steel$(): smelt a blend of iron, bone meal and coal. Then make $(item)Neuro-Copper Wire$(), a $(item)Lens$() and a $(item)Servo$(). Power comes from a $(item)Galvanic Pile$() fed with meat.
